items.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Faces Rising Hedge Fund Caution
items.summary: Hedge funds trimmed or exited positions in Broadcom (NasdaqGS: AVGO) in Q2 2026, rotating capital into other large semiconductor and tech stocks. Duquesne Family Office and Altimeter Capital shifted exposure toward companies such as Amazon, TSMC, and Lam Research. Managers cited concerns around Broadcom's valuation, customer concentration, and margin pressures despite strong AI semiconductor revenue growth.
